performance-baseline-01.scope: Existing stationary-spawn host logs, 110-178 seconds; capture interval excluded by painted frame ID. No traversal or console evidence.
caveats: Waits shorter than 5 ms are not logged.
Frame-close marker does not prove all timestamp samples were retained.
GPU work and CPU waits overlap; do not add them.
Logs do not identify the caller of CheckSubmissionFence.
